info.prompt: Dice float suspended in a void-black laboratory chamber, their faceted "ice-stone" surfaces refracting jagged neon cyan beams that slice through thick alchemical fog, skeletal UI panels etched with glowing synaptic pathways flicker as a rogue-class pip system charges up beside a pulsing BREAK IT! prompt, the whole scene viewed through a warped fisheye lens with chromatic aberration distorting the edges where the neural cathedral architecture dissolves into data-noise.
